android.releaseNotes:
• E2EE Sent Message Fix: Fixed sent messages reverting to 'Message encrypted' upon server echo or reload by guaranteeing sender plaintext preservation and caching across real-time events.
• WhatsApp-Style Push Previews: Replaced raw ciphertext and internal placeholders with clean contextual notification previews (Photo, Video, Voice message, Document, Poll, or New message).
• Background & Killed Push Delivery: Fixed push notification delivery on Android devices when app is closed or in deep sleep by preventing premature background account suppression and adding high-priority FCM notification channel payloads.
